about_the_game:
Romance of the Three Kingdoms is an action-packed level-clearing game deeply rooted in the turbulent and legendary history of China’s Three Kingdoms period, offering players an immersive journey to relive the era’s heroic battles and strategic clashes.​

1. Playable Generals & Skill Systems​

The game features a roster of iconic Three Kingdoms generals, with Guan Yu, Zhao Yun, and Zhang Fei as core playable characters—each designed to reflect their historical traits and combat styles.​

  • Guan Yu: Wields the legendary Green Dragon Crescent Blade, with exclusive skills like "Green Dragon Crescent Slash" (a wide-range slash that cuts through multiple enemies) and "Righteous Charge" (a forward dash that stuns foes). His ultimate move, "Divine Blade Judgment," unleashes a devastating circular attack that deals massive damage to all nearby enemies.​

  • Zhao Yun: Masters the spear, excelling in agility and precision. His signature "Spear Thrust" pierces through single targets with high damage, while "Whirlwind Spear" spins the weapon to hit surrounding foes. His ultimate, "Dragon Soars Through Battlefield," lets him dash repeatedly across the map, striking down enemies in his path.​

  • Zhang Fei: Relies on brute strength with his Serpent Spear. Skills like "Fierce Roar" intimidate enemies, reducing their defense, and "Ground Smash" slams the spear into the ground, creating a shockwave. His ultimate, "Tiger’s Wrath," boosts his attack power drastically and lets him unleash a series of heavy strikes.​

To unlock and upgrade these skills, players need to earn Merit Points—obtained by defeating enemy soldiers, eliminating elite foes, or completing level objectives (e.g., protecting allied troops, seizing enemy flags). Merit Points also let players enhance core attributes like health, attack, and defense, tailoring each general to their playstyle.​

2. Level Design & Battle Challenges​

Levels are meticulously crafted to recreate famous Three Kingdoms battlefields and events, with Hulao Pass and Changbanpo as standout stages, each with unique terrain, enemies, and objectives:​

  • Hulao Pass: A fortress-level where players must breach enemy defenses, navigate narrow corridors lined with archers, and avoid rolling boulders (terrain traps). The stage culminates in a boss fight against Lü Bu—the "Fiercest Warrior Under Heaven"—who wields a halberd, charges at high speed, and unleashes "Heaven-Shaking Strike" (a one-hit-kill move if not dodged).​

  • Changbanpo: A large, open battlefield 重现赵云单骑救主的 scenario. Players need to fight through waves of Cao Cao’s troops, rescue trapped allied civilians, and avoid cavalry charges. The boss here is Cao Ren (Cao Cao’s cousin), who uses shield-based attacks and summons reinforcements to overwhelm players.​

Other levels include "Red Cliff" (with naval combat and fire trap mechanics) and "Xuchang Siege" (a siege battle where players must destroy enemy towers to progress), ensuring varied gameplay that avoids repetition.​

3. Cooperative Gameplay & Collection Systems​

The game supports 2-player local co-op, allowing friends to team up and combine general skills for more strategic combat. For example, Zhang Fei can use "Fierce Roar" to weaken enemies, while Guan Yu follows up with "Green Dragon Crescent Slash" to clear crowds; or Zhao Yun can dash to distract bosses, giving his partner time to charge ultimate moves.​

After clearing levels, players collect Three Kingdoms Relics—rare items like "Guan Yu’s Red Hare Horse Figurine," "Zhao Yun’s Battle Flag," or "Zhang Fei’s Wine Flask." These relics serve two purposes:​

  • Unlocking character skins: For example, a "Golden Armor" skin for Guan Yu or a "White Robe" skin for Zhao Yun, which also grant small attribute bonuses.​

  • Unlocking hidden storylines: Short cutscenes that expand on the generals’ backstories (e.g., Guan Yu’s journey from Hua Xiong’s defeat to his escape from Cao Cao) or untold side events of the Three Kingdoms era, adding depth to the game’s narrative.​

4. Core Gameplay Loop​

The core loop revolves around "battle → earn Merit Points → upgrade skills/attributes → tackle harder levels → collect relics → unlock extras." This loop keeps players engaged, as each level victory feels rewarding—whether it’s unlocking a powerful ultimate move, getting a new skin, or uncovering a hidden story snippet—while the increasing difficulty of later stages (e.g., fighting multiple bosses at once, navigating complex traps) ensures a satisfying challenge for action game fans.
